name: A Very Full House
source:
It's a game about love, seduction, and corruption, all centered around a MILF-y main character. Do your best to take control of your household and keep everything under control, by any means necessary!

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/MetaMira/about]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
这是一款关于爱情、诱惑和腐败的游戏，一切都以熟女主角为中心。尽最大努力控制你的家庭，并通过任何必要的手段控制一切！

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/MetaMira/about]Patreon[/url]]
